metadata.title: Courses
metadata.description: Courses, tutorials and projects with their chapters, lessons and videos.

title: Courses
description: Courses, tutorials and projects, built from chapters and lessons that each hold their own video. Drag a course by its handle, or use the arrow keys on it, to set the order of the catalogue while the list is neither sorted nor filtered.

actions.copyFailed: The link could not be copied

table.emptyDescription: Create the first one or import a course file.

delete.title: {count, plural, one {Delete this course?} other {Delete # courses?}}
delete.body: {count, plural, one {“{title}”, its chapters, its lessons and everyone’s progress in it are removed, and its uploads are cancelled. Its videos stay available to other lessons.} other {These # courses, their chapters, their lessons and everyone’s progress in them are removed, and their uploads are cancelled. Their videos stay available to other lessons.}}
delete.success: {count, plural, one {“{title}” was deleted} other {# courses were deleted}}

outcomes.label: What learners will be able to do

cover.title: Cover
cover.description: The image on the course's card, page and landing page tile. Without one, the course shows its icon on a teal glow.
cover.hint: {types}, up to {max, number} MB. It is cropped to 16:9 and saved at {width} × {height} pixels, with two smaller copies for phones.
cover.unreadable: This image could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG file.

editor.description: Edit the details, then build the curriculum from chapters and lessons.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.reorderHint: Drag a chapter or a lesson by its handle to move it, a lesson into another chapter too. With the keyboard: focus the handle, press Enter, choose the place with the arrow keys and press Enter again.
curriculum.empty: No chapters yet. Add the first one to start the curriculum.
curriculum.noLessons: No lessons in this chapter yet.
curriculum.deleteChapterBody: “{name}” and its lessons are removed, along with learners’ progress in them and any upload in progress. Their videos stay available to other lessons.
curriculum.deleteLessonBody: “{name}” and learners’ progress in it are removed, and an upload in progress is cancelled. Its video stays available to other lessons.

lesson.title: Lesson title
lesson.recordingHint: Optional. It uploads once the lesson is saved, while you keep working.
lesson.savedUploading: Lesson saved. Its recording is uploading.

lessonEditor.pageDescription: Edit the lesson's text, its key moments, its video and its materials.
lessonEditor.descriptionHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line and put code between {mark} marks, like {example}.

keyMoments.label: Key moments
keyMoments.hint: Each moment is a time in the video, such as 2:15, and a label. Learners jump to it from the lesson page.
keyMoments.title: Label of moment {number}

video.title: Video
video.description: The lesson's recording. Until a video is ready, learners see the lesson as coming soon.

drop.label: Upload the lesson's recording
drop.title: Drop the recording here
drop.hint: {types} up to {max, number} GB. Large files upload in parts and pick up where they stopped.

video.ready: Plays for everyone who may open the lesson
video.removeBody: Every file encoded from “{title}” is deleted, and the lesson shows as coming soon until it gets another video.
video.detachTitle: Remove this video from the lesson?
video.detachBody: “{title}” stays on the {count, plural, one {other lesson} other {# other lessons}} that use it.
video.keepOpen: Keep this tab open until the upload finishes. If it stops, choose the same file again and it continues where it stopped.
video.interrupted: The upload of {file} stopped before it finished. Choose the same file to continue it.
video.queuedHint: {file} is uploaded. Run the encoder on a machine with FFmpeg to turn it into adaptive streams; the lesson plays as soon as it finishes.
video.encodingHint: The lesson keeps its current video, if it has one, until this one is ready.

failures.unreadable: FFmpeg could not read {file} as a video. Upload another recording.
failures.encoding: FFmpeg stopped before {file} was encoded. Encode it again, or upload another recording.

video.text: This is a text lesson: learners read its description and use its materials.

noVideo.label: This lesson has no video
noVideo.description: For a lesson learners read, or one that only offers materials. It is listed as a text lesson, never as coming soon.
noVideo.locked: Delete the video or cancel its upload first to make this a lesson without a video.

picker.title: Use an existing video
picker.description: Videos already encoded for this site, newest first. One video can play in several lessons.
picker.empty: No videos yet. Upload the first one in a lesson.
picker.usage: {count, plural, =0 {Not used by any lesson} one {Used in # lesson} other {Used in # lessons}}
picker.deleteBody: No lesson uses “{title}”. Every file encoded from it is deleted.

materials.title: Materials
materials.description: Files and links that come with the lesson. Learners get them only when they may open the lesson.
materials.reorderHint: Drag a material by its handle to move it. With the keyboard: focus the handle, press Enter, choose the place with the arrow keys and press Enter again.
materials.deleteBody: “{title}” is removed from the lesson, and an uploaded file is deleted from storage.

dialog.title: Import courses
dialog.description: Courses are matched by their slug, lessons by their slug within the course and chapters by their order. Check the file first: nothing is written until you import it, and importing the same file twice changes nothing.
dialog.files: The file carries the text, access levels, key moments, links and video references of each lesson. Uploaded materials do not travel in it: they stay on their lessons here.
dialog.fileHint: A JSON file written by Export.
dialog.removeMissing: Remove what the file does not contain
dialog.removeMissingHint: Deletes the courses, chapters, lessons and links that are not in the file, with learners' progress and the uploaded materials of the deleted lessons. Leave it off to only add and update.

plan.title: Importing this file will make these changes:
plan.noChanges: Nothing to import: the courses here already match the file.
plan.problems: {count, plural, one {The file has # problem, so nothing can be imported:} other {The file has # problems, so nothing can be imported:}}
plan.moreProblems: {count, plural, one {and # more problem} other {and # more problems}}
plan.tally: {create, number} to add, {update, number} to update, {unchanged, number} unchanged, {remove, number} to remove, {keep, number} not in the file and kept
plan.files: {count, plural, one {# uploaded file is deleted with its lesson.} other {# uploaded files are deleted with their lessons.}}
plan.videoMissing: {course}, {lesson}: video {videoId} is not on this site, so the lesson keeps its current video.
